# THEA at the Table

> THEA at the Table (formerly Theasty, est. 2017) is the food, travel and lifestyle site of Thea VanHerwaarden, a MasterChef Canada finalist (Top 2), recipe developer and Canadian food and lifestyle television expert. Tagline: "Everyday food, lived beautifully." Home cooking that is seasonal, approachable and elevated, plus restaurant reviews and press.

Key facts:
- Author: Thea VanHerwaarden, MasterChef Canada Top 2 finalist; her n'duja ricotta tortellini was featured on the menu at Jamie Oliver's Jamie's Italian.
- Content: original tested recipes (pasta, braises, brunch, baking, drinks), restaurant and travel reviews, and press features.
- Every recipe page includes structured ingredients, step-by-step method and schema.org Recipe markup.
- Contact for partnerships and media: thea@theasty.com

## Recipes
- [Braised Short Rib and Mussels](https://theasty.com/braised-beef-with-mussels-using-canada-beef/): West Coast flavours mean seafood. But B.C. beef holds its own. I teamed up with Canada Beef to give surf and turf a West Coast spin: braised short rib and mussels.
- [Beaver Tails](https://theasty.com/beaver-tail-recipe/): A Canadian staple, at least in my house. Craving something sweet? Try Beaver Tails.
- [Eggs Benny Breakfast Pizza](https://theasty.com/eggs-benedict-breakfast-pizza-eggs-benny/): Eggs Benedict as a thin-crust pizza, with hollandaise and green onion. Pizza for breakfast, done properly.
- [Crispy Skin Salmon with Mango Salsa](https://theasty.com/crispy-skin-salmon-with-mango-salsa/): Crispy skin salmon with mango, corn and black bean salsa. Ready in under 20 minutes and easy to scale.
- [Théasty Beef Ramen](https://theasty.com/theasty-beef-ramen/): Rich spicy broth, tender steak, noodles and a boiled egg, with lime, cilantro and chili for a slight Thai twist.
- [Thea’s Théasty Smashburgers](https://theasty.com/theasty-smashburgers/): Ultra crispy edges, no filler. My fan-favourite smashburgers, finally on the blog after many requests.
- [Lazy Artisan Bread](https://theasty.com/lazy-artisan-bread/): Four ingredients, no knead, and crunchy outside, soft inside. Make it a day ahead.
- [Maple Whiskey Fried Chicken with Cornmeal Pancakes and Herb-Chili Maple Syrup](https://theasty.com/maple-whiskey-buttermilk-fried-chicken-buttermilk-cornmeal-pancakes-with-herb-and-chili-maple-syrup/): My waffle maker broke, so: pancakes. A bottle of unopened Canadian maple whiskey went into the chicken marinade. Chicken and waffles, headed north, and now my favourite version.
- [Braised Chili in Adobo Beef Tacos with Roasted Pineapple Salsa](https://theasty.com/braised-chili-in-adobo-beef-tacos-with-roasted-pineapple-salsa/): Braised adobo beef tacos made in the pressure cooker, with pineapple two ways. Dutch oven works too: about 3 hours at 350 F.
- [Classic Cranberry Sauce with Balsamic Vinegar](https://theasty.com/classic-cranberry-sauce-with-balsamic-vinegar/): Classic homemade cranberry sauce, made with Giulia Lombardo of Just Giulia for holiday spreads.
- [Pumpkin Spice Biscotti](https://theasty.com/pumpkin-spice-biscotti/): Pumpkin spice, dried cranberries and toasted hazelnuts in a biscotti made for dunking in your coffee.
- [Stuffing Waffle Turkey Sandwich](https://theasty.com/stuffing-waffles/): The stuffing waffle people ask me about every year. Eat it with a fried egg, or as the bread in a turkey sandwich.
- [Braised Short Rib Ragu](https://theasty.com/braised-short-rib-ragu/): Short rib ragu in one pot. Red wine, tomatoes and herbs, with fresh trofie made while it braises.
- [Greek Kebabs with Tzatziki + Garlic Naan](https://theasty.com/greek-kebabs/): Kebabs for a friend's birthday, with homemade tzatziki and garlic naan. Store-bought is fine too.
- [Blackberry Sweet Rolls](https://theasty.com/blackberry-sweet-rolls/): Wild blackberries grow everywhere in late summer. I baked them into sticky buns with cinnamon.
- [Théasty New York-Style Bagels](https://theasty.com/new-york-style-bagels/): New York-style bagels at home: chewier, bigger, and no harder than a loaf of bread, plus a boil.
- [Street Corn Chicken Enchiladas](https://theasty.com/street-corn-chicken-enchiladas/): Street corn chicken enchiladas for weeknights: spiced chicken, green sauce, roasted corn and cheese. Store-bought shortcuts welcome.
- [Peach and Burrata Pasta with Crispy Prosciutto](https://theasty.com/peaches-n-cream/): Pasta is my blank canvas, and peaches are the last of summer. Burrata instead of a cream sauce, plus sweet corn and crispy prosciutto.
- [Pillow Soft Pretzels](https://theasty.com/pillow-soft-pretzels/): Soft pretzels were my childhood favourite. After trying many recipes, this is the one. Best eaten within a day.
- [Simple Bruschetta](https://theasty.com/bruschetta/): Directions: Preheat oven to 400 degree Fahrenheit.  On a large baking sheet line the sliced baguette in rows and drizzle with olive oil.  Place in oven and allow to crisp up (approx. 5-8 minutes).…
- [Chicken, Watermelon and Burrata Sandwich](https://theasty.com/chicken-watermelon-and-burrata-sandwich/): Half a watermelon needed using. Result: an open-faced sandwich with burrata and grilled chicken.
- [Simple Crepes](https://theasty.com/simple-crepes/): The first recipe my mother taught me. Crepes are thin, rich, flexible, and I have never measured them.
- [Simple Watermelon Salsa](https://theasty.com/watermelon-salsa/): Pico with a juicy twist. Watermelon salsa for tacos, BBQ chicken, breakfast or just chips. Hard to mess up.
- [Spicy Goat Cheese + Sausage Rigatoni with Green Vegetables](https://theasty.com/sausage-rigatoni/): First use of my new pasta press: spicy sausage rigatoni with spring vegetables and goat cheese.
- [Blood Orange Peach + Berry Dutch Babies](https://theasty.com/blood-orange-peach-berry-dutch-babies/): Leftover blood oranges, peaches and berries on Dutch babies with honey whipped ricotta. Brunch from the fridge.
- [Blood Orange Jalapeno Margarita](https://theasty.com/blood-orange-jalapeno-margarita/): Spicy, on the rocks, and made with fresh blood orange instead of orange liqueur.
- [Brioche Buns](https://theasty.com/brioche-buns/): Fluffy, golden brioche buns for burger season, and they stay fluffy instead of going stale overnight.
- [Steak & Watermelon Tacos](https://theasty.com/steak-watermelon-tacos/): *you can use any type of steak for the recipe, I prefer tenderloin or marinated flank steak (seen above).  Directions: For the Steak Add garlic, chili powder, olive oil, lime juice and cilantro in a…
- [Italian Eggs in Purgatory](https://theasty.com/italian-eggs-in-purgatory/): Eggs cooked in spicy tomato sauce, with Italian sausage, garlic and chili flakes, served on garlic-rubbed sourdough.
- [Creamy Chicken Marsala](https://theasty.com/creamy-chicken-marsala/): Smells like it cooked for hours, takes one pan and half an hour. A play on a classic Italian dish.
- [Sweet Chili Corn Soup](https://theasty.com/sweet-chili-corn-soup/): Corn's natural sweetness, a hint of honey and a kick of chili. Throw it in a pot and blend. Basically.
- [Beef Stroganoff](https://theasty.com/beef-stroganoff/): Every week for years, I ordered the beef Stroganoff at the French restaurant where my parents took us and the chefs let us brûlée our own desserts. The restaurant is gone. The Stroganoff isn't.
- [Sheet Pan Steak Tacos](https://theasty.com/sheet-pan-steak-tacos/): If I could eat one thing for the rest of my life, it would be tacos. This sheet pan version is easy and quick.
- [Southwestern Salad in a Jar](https://theasty.com/southwestern-salad-in-a-jar/): A grab-and-go Southwestern salad in a jar. Oven chicken, lime juice, and it keeps for 4 to 6 days.
- [Energy Balls](https://theasty.com/energy-balls/): It is 3 o'clock, you want something sweet and salty, and a handful of nuts will not cut it. These take ten minutes and keep me away from the newsstand chocolate bars.
- [Breakfast Burritos To Go](https://theasty.com/breakfast-burritos-to-go/): Breakfast burritos that are easy to make and quick to grab on the way out the door.
- [Pink Cacio e Pepe](https://theasty.com/pink-cacio-e-pepe/): A Valentine's dish for staying in: pink cacio e pepe in 15 minutes, with a sauce that is basically melted butter.
- [Cheddar & Onion Cornbread](https://theasty.com/cheddar-onion-cornbread/): After dozens of failed attempts, a cornbread that holds together. Cheddar, green onion, cake flour and oil.
- [The Best Meatless Chili](https://theasty.com/vegetarian-chili/): Vegetarian chili, with beans, and Gardein beefless ground that might fool your friends. Cheddar and onion cornbread on the side.
- [Red Wine Braised Short Rib Pappardelle](https://theasty.com/red-wine-braised-short-rib-papardelle/): Red wine braised short ribs that fall off the bone, over fresh pappardelle with mushrooms.
- [Sweet Chili Chicken Lettuce Wraps](https://theasty.com/sweet-chili-chicken-lettuce-wraps/): Tacos, lightened up. Lettuce wraps with sweet chili chicken: a little Asian inspiration on a Mexican base.
- [Mexi Breakfast Bowl](https://theasty.com/mexi-breakfast-bowl/): Spicy Italian sausage, crispy potatoes, black beans, salsa and avocado, topped with poached eggs. Filling, and quick enough for a crowd.
- [Green Vegetable Soup](https://theasty.com/green-vegetable-soup/): A green vegetable soup with a kick from poblano and jalapeno, freezer-friendly and simple to make.
- [Truffle Mushroom & Spinach Pizza with Roasted Garlic](https://theasty.com/truffle-mushroom-spinach-pizza-with-roasted-garlic/): Thin crust, light mozzarella, spinach, mushrooms and roasted garlic. A January pizza with nothing to apologize for.
- [Chili Chocolate Crinkle Cookies](https://theasty.com/chili-chocolate-crinkle-cookies/): Crinkle cookies that look like snow on mountain peaks, with soft chocolate inside and a hint of chili. Skip the spice if you must.
- [Cheese-Stuffed Pasta Shells with Winter Vegetables](https://theasty.com/cheese-stuffed-pasta-shells-with-winter-vegetables/): Mac and cheese, winter edition: kale, broccoli, butternut squash and pancetta. Comforting, make-ahead, and sneaky enough to fool the harshest child critic. I added chili, because I put it in…
- [Almond Biscotti](https://theasty.com/biscotti/): Crunchy, not tooth-chipping, and made for dunking. Biscotti are not hard, and the name tells you why: baked twice.
- [Southwestern White Chicken Chili](https://theasty.com/southwestern-white-chicken-chili/): A sunny white bean chili with chunks of chicken instead of ground beef. The bean debate in our house continues.
- [Butternut Squash Pasta, Brown Butter Sage Sauce](https://theasty.com/butternut-squash-pasta-brown-butter-sage-sauce/): Noodles made from butternut squash: one can of squash, some flour. Finished with sage brown butter.
- [BC Summer Eats with Red Rooster Winery](https://theasty.com/bc-summer-eats-with-red-rooster-winery/): Recipes built on local, in-season B.C. produce, paired with Red Rooster Rare Bird Series 2017 Rose.
- [White Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies with Himalayan Sea Salt](https://theasty.com/salted-white-chocolate-peanut-butter-cookies/): Peanut butter cookies, kicked up with Himalayan sea salt and a white chocolate dip. Sweet, salty and super easy.
- [Sweet & Spicy Chicken, Mango Salsa & Coconut Rice](https://theasty.com/sweet-spicy-chicken-mango-salsa-coconut-rice/): Sticky, sweet and spicy chicken with mango salsa and coconut rice. A lighter take on BBQ (or grilling, according to Texan).
- [Vegetarian Taco Salad](https://theasty.com/vegetarian-taco-salad/): A vegetarian taco salad made with Gardein plant-based products.
- [Mexican Street Corn](https://theasty.com/mexican-street-corn/): My all-time favourite snack. Inexpensive, quick, easy, and a good starter or party contribution.
- [Taco Cookies](https://theasty.com/taco-cookies/): Tiny tacos made of cookies. The adults will talk, the kids will run wild on sugar, and they are easier to assemble than they look.
- [Rosé Margaritas](https://theasty.com/rose-margaritas/): Two warm weather staples in one glass: a fun play on a classic margarita, made with Rosé.
- [Fresh Tagliatelle with Tomatoes and Olive Oil](https://theasty.com/fresh-tagliatelle-with-tomatoes-and-olive-oil/): Fresh tagliatelle, tomatoes and olive oil. Quick, simple, and eaten straight out of the pan.
- [Asparagus and Pea Soup](https://theasty.com/green-asparagus-pea-soup/): Big flavour in a tiny bowl. A green spring soup of peas and asparagus that even little ones will eat.
- [Death by Chocolate Banana Muffins](https://theasty.com/death-by-chocolate-banana-muffins/): My mom's chocolate banana muffins made me the boss of recess snacks. Super easy, kid-approved, and I never wanted to trade.
- [Black Trumpet Risotto](https://theasty.com/black-trumpet-risotto/): I don't like mushroom texture but love the flavour. Black trumpets, curious since Masterchef, finally get a risotto.
- [Jalapeño Corn Gnocchi with Crispy Pancetta](https://theasty.com/jalapeno-corn-gnocchi-crispy-panchetta/): Jalapeno corn gnocchi with crispy pancetta: Mexican and Italian, my two favourite cuisines, on one plate.
- [Huevos Breakfast Pizza](https://theasty.com/huevos-breakfast-pizza/): A hangover cure that can feed an army: breakfast pizza for the morning after New Year's Eve.
- [Gingerbread Bundt Cake](https://theasty.com/gingerbread-bundt-cake/): Gingerbread, plain and warm from the oven. This bundt stays moist for days and freezes well.
- [Gourmet Rig n’ Cheese](https://theasty.com/gourmet-rig-n-cheese/): Mac and cheese with large rigatoni, and a smart way to use up the cheese before it goes bad. Easy, and made for a cold night.
- [Mexican Hot Chocolate Cookies](https://theasty.com/mexican-hot-chocolate-cookies/): Chocolate, chili and sea salt in a cookie. Soft, gooey, with spice that warms the back of your throat.
- [Black Pumpkin Ravioli, Brown Butter Sage Sauce](https://theasty.com/black-pumpkin-ravioli/): Black pumpkin ravioli with brown butter sage sauce: a classic with a dark twist, colored with squid ink or food coloring.
- [Spiced Apple & Pumpkin Soup](https://theasty.com/spiced-apple-pumpkin-soup/): Pumpkin and B.C. apples in one pot. It freezes well, goes vegan easily, and leftovers turn into a pasta sauce.
- [4 Fun Thanksgiving Leftover Recipes](https://theasty.com/4-fun-thanksgiving-leftover-recipes/): Too much turkey, stuffing and cranberry sauce? Start with a stuffing waffle turkey sandwich, ready in under 5 minutes.
- [Huevos Rancheros](https://theasty.com/huevos-rancheros/): Some people have a hard-boiled egg and toast. I have huevos rancheros, because there is always leftover Mexican food in my fridge. (Written straight after the gym, and I'm still salivating.)
- [Vegetarian Ramen](https://theasty.com/vegetarian-ramen/): I never tried ramen until this year. Now I want it daily. A meat-free bowl, ready in under 30 minutes.
- [Chocolate Blueberry Seed Muffins](https://theasty.com/chocolate-blueberry-seed-muffins/): Eggs, milk and half a container of blueberries. Muffins in 30 minutes, and the world's your muffin.
- [Veg-orizo Tortellini with Broccolini and Tomato Broth](https://theasty.com/veg-tortellini/): A vegetarian riff on chorizo and ricotta tortellini, with broccolini and tomato broth. You may second guess that it's meatless.
- [Spicy Peanut Buddha Bowl](https://theasty.com/buddha-bowl/): A spicy peanut Buddha bowl, packed with protein, fridge-friendly and good for leftovers. Inspired by my friend Jaimee.

- [Spicy Summer Tagliatelle](https://theasty.com/easy-spicy-summer-tagliatelle/): Chorizo, broccoli rabe, lemon and peas with fresh tagliatelle, made from a nearly empty fridge and a freezer find.

- [Halibut with Mango Salsa and Jalapeño Corn Sauce](https://theasty.com/halibut-mango-salsa/): Halibut with golden skin, mango salsa, jalapeño corn sauce and a citrusy pea shoot salad. A lot happening on one plate, in the best way.

- [Caesar Salad](https://theasty.com/caesar-salad/): Caesar salad with homemade croutons and mayo-free dressing. Same flavour, fewer calories.
- [Rosé Sorbet](https://theasty.com/rose-sorbe/): Frosé is a dream but takes a lot of steps. Lime sorbet, Rosé and fresh thyme get you there faster.
